title: Man. Post. Cap. IX: PLAC — your imputation also overthrows original vice and God’s φιλανθρωπία
pass_a_gloss: Placeus: the imputation you defend not only abolishes original vice—which still sits marrow-deep in every one of us, as Scripture and experience shout—but also undermines God’s φιλανθρωπία (love of mankind).
pass_b_english: Nor does the imputation you defend only take away original vice—which nevertheless is, alas, fixed marrow-deep in all and each of us, and Scripture cries out and experience bears witness—but it also undermines God’s φιλανθρωπία.
source_text: Non modo autem imputatio quam tueris tollit vitium originale, quod tamen nobis, proh dolor, omnibus & singulis medullitus infixum est, & Scriptura clamat & experientia contestatur, sed ea quoque Dei φιλανθρωπίαν labefactat.

choices.choice: Imputation kills original vice and God’s φιλανθρωπία
